title: Understand & Scope
summary: Clarifying the core problem, user expectations, and functional requirements before writing any code.
detail: Review requirements, identify edge cases, define data models, and align on deliverables and tech stack constraints.

title: Architecture & Schema Design
summary: Structuring database relationships and application layers for reliability and future maintainability.
detail: Design relational tables in SQL Server, establish Entity Framework Core mappings, and organize projects into clear domain, data, and presentation layers.

title: Build & Implement
summary: Developing type-safe C# backend logic, secure endpoints, and responsive user interfaces.
detail: Implement controllers, business services, authentication flows with ASP.NET Identity, and accessible front-end views using Bootstrap and JavaScript.

title: Test & Refine
summary: Validating behavior across typical and edge cases to ensure dependable operation.
detail: Test business logic, verify database migrations and transactional operations, check mobile responsiveness, and polish input validation.

title: Deliver & Document
summary: Handing over working software with clear configuration instructions and readable code structure.
detail: Provide clean Git history, document setup and environment settings, and ensure straightforward deployment.
